definitions: To say something foolish, tactless, or embarrassing.
To inadvertently say something that offends or upsets someone.
examples: I really stuck my foot in my mouth when I asked about her ex-husband.
He tends to stick his foot in his mouth at every family gathering.
Try not to stick your foot in your mouth during the interview.
lemma: stick one's foot in one's mouth
source: stick one's foot in one's mouth
